params.q: Which coaching institute did Rajeshwari Suve M, UPSC CSE 2025 AIR 2, study at?

response.reconstructed_markdown:

- Mentorship and Guidance: Associated with the [Vajirao and Reddy Institute](https://www.vajiraoinstitute.com/upsc-topper-stories/rajeshwari-suve-m-rank-2-ias-upsc-topper-2025.aspx).
- Test Series: Utilized the online test series provided by [Vajiram and Ravi](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/IeU06hIlWDQ) to refine her Prelims preparation. [0] [1]
